key_risks: Raw material price volatility (copper, aluminium, polymers) and currency fluctuations

Employee turnover and poaching of key technical personnel
Working capital risk due to economic downturn and delayed receivables
Liquidated damages risk from short delivery contracts
Project execution risk from statutory obligations like right-of-way permissions
Growth stagnation risk from low-margin high-volume strategy
Product development failure risk involving high testing costs
Brand attrition risk from new competitors
Artificial trade barriers and protectionism in export markets
